sheet:
Reference images. Image 1: style and character reference - Kai (silver-white hair, black sweater), Aoi (mother) and their daughter, waving.

STYLE: Soft pastel anime webtoon panel. Muted, low-contrast, cool lavender-grey color grading, hazy soft daylight from a window with gentle bloom, thin clean lineart, soft cel-shading, calm cozy slice-of-life manhwa mood. Same art style and colors as the reference images. No text, no speech bubbles, no letters.

KAI: Kai, the father: young man with messy layered silver-white hair that partly covers his eyes, pale lilac-grey eyes, small black stud earring, oversized plain black long-sleeve crewneck sweater, black pants.

AOI: Aoi, the mother: young woman with very long straight pastel periwinkle-blue hair to her waist, a thin side braid, a white five-petal flower hairclip, white long-sleeve nightgown with frilled cuffs, a ribbon tie at the chest and tiny pale flower print.

DAUGHTER: Their daughter: a 4-year-old girl with long pastel periwinkle-blue hair, a thin side braid, the same white five-petal flower hairclip, round soft face with big eyes, white long-sleeve nightgown with a ribbon collar and tiny pale flower print.

ACTION: Character turnaround sheet on a plain white background: Kai, Aoi and their daughter standing side by side, full body, front view, relaxed neutral smiles, evenly lit, nothing else in frame.

Avoid: t-shirt, white shirt, grey shirt, dress shirt, navy or dark blue hair, short hair, bob cut, pink dress, warm orange lighting, saturated colors, thick outlines, glossy shading, any text
